candidates.change_summary: Replace call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with withdrawing a fixed constant 0, causing withdrawAll to transfer 0 instead of the contract balance.
Replace call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with direct call to withdraw with msg.sender balance, causing withdrawAll to send the caller's balance (likely 0) instead of contract balance.
Remove the call to withdraw so withdrawAll becomes a no-op (does not transfer funds), leaving state unchanged.
Change onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (remove the require), so withdrawAll can be called by non-owners and thus its observable effect can differ.
Replace transfer to send funds to owner using call which returns success bool but does not require success, allowing partial/failed transfers to leave contract balance unchanged.
Modify onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), permitting non-owners to call withdraw and thus change which address receives funds.
Change withdraw to send funds to the contract itself (address(this)) instead of msg.sender, altering final balances seen after withdraw.
Change the call to use transfer instead of low-level call, which will revert on failure differently and may alter state observable through sendMoney behavior.
Invert the require result to allow silent failure instead of reverting, changing whether the call reverts and thus observable behavior after sendMoney.
Remove the require so failures of the low-level call do not revert, altering whether subsequent state changes observed after sendMoney occur.
Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner, flipping authorization so different callers can invoke sendMoney, altering observable behavior.
